result.stdout:
Usage: SyncChanges.Service install [OPTION]...
       SyncChanges.Service uninstall [--name=NAME]
Install or uninstall the SyncChanges Windows service. Requires an elevated command prompt.
The service reads its configuration from /usr/share/SyncChanges/config.json, unless --config is given.

Options:
  -n, --name=VALUE           Name of the service (default is SyncChangesService)
  -u, --user=VALUE           Account the service runs as, e.g. .\UserName,
                               DOMAIN\UserName, NetworkService or NT SERVICE\
                               SyncChangesService (default is LocalSystem)
  -p, --password=VALUE       Password of the account; asked for if the account
                               needs one and it is not given
  -c, --config=VALUE         Configuration file of the service (default is /usr/
                               share/SyncChanges/config.json); the log is
                               written to its folder
  -s, --start                Start the service once it is installed
  -h, --help                 Show this message and exit
